en: The front of the postcard depicts the interior of an ornately decorated room with vaulted ceilings, filled with chairs, tables, animal mounts, glassware, framed pictures, and various curiosities on the walls. The setting conveys the feeling of an old-tavern or 'Kneipe' style room, suggesting tradition and history. The back features standard postcard layout elements in German, including printed lines for an address, and a logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
